function.name: open_classes_key

parameters.name: hkey

parameters.name: access

function.return_type: LSTATUS, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, the return value is ERROR_SUCCESS. If the function fails, the return value is a system error code.

function.name: open_key_for_clsid
function.description: This function opens a registry key associated with a given CLSID. If the key name is provided, it opens the subkey of the CLSID key.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: The CLSID for which the key is to be opened.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: The access level requested for the key.

parameters.name: subkey
parameters.description: A pointer to a variable that receives a handle to the opened key. If the keyname parameter is NULL, this handle is to the key for the CLSID.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the function succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the function fails because the specified key cannot be found, the return value is REGDB_E_CLASSNOTREG or REGDB_E_KEYMISSING. If the function fails for any other reason, the return value is REGDB_E_READREGDB.

function.name: open_appidkey_from_clsid
function.description: This function opens the AppID key from a given class identifier (CLSID). It first reads the AppID value under the class's key, then constructs the key name and opens the classes key.

parameters.name: clsid
parameters.description: This is the class identifier from which the AppID key is to be opened.

parameters.name: access
parameters.description: This is the desired access rights to the key.

parameters.name: subkey
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a variable that receives a handle to the opened key.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where a successful operation returns S_OK. If the function fails, it returns an error code. For example, if the AppID value under the class's key is not found or if the classes key cannot be opened, it returns REGDB_E_KEYMISSING. If there is a failure in reading the registry database, it returns REGDB_E_READREGDB.

function.name: CoRevokeClassObject
function.description: This function revokes a previously registered class object, so that it is no longer available for clients to connect to. It checks if the COM was initialized, gets the current apartment, enters a critical section, and then iterates over the registered classes. If the cookie of the current class matches the input cookie and the apartment ID of the current class matches the oxid of the current apartment, it revokes the class object and sets the HRESULT to S_OK. If the apartment IDs don't match, it sets the HRESULT to RPC_E_WRONG_THREAD. Finally, it leaves the critical section, releases the apartment, and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: cookie
parameters.description: This is an identifier for the class object to be revoked.

function.return_type: DECLSPEC_HOTPATCH, represents the status of the operation. It can be E_INVALIDARG if the argument is invalid, CO_E_NOTINITIALIZED if the COM was not initialized, S_OK if the operation was successful, or RPC_E_WRONG_THREAD if the function was called from the wrong apartment.
